background_image_description: Off-white textured paper with subtle fiber/grain noise, overlaid by evenly spaced vertical stripes alternating very light gray (#f6f6f6) and pale gray (#e8e8e8) running full height.

nodes.asset_description: Full-canvas background pattern of vertical alternating light gray stripes on a softly textured paper surface; stripes are uniform in width and extend from top to bottom.

nodes.svg_description: Single-color hand-drawn illustration in deep cobalt blue (#1f3f9a): a double-outlined vertical oval platter with an inner ring of evenly spaced dots; centered inside is a sketchy lobster with large raised claws, segmented tail, antennae, and legs. Brushy strokes vary in thickness, with a few white highlight streaks suggesting shine along the tail and claw edges.
